grammar.summary: 本课学习表愿望的 should like 与 without + 名词让步。

points.title: should like to do 表意愿
points.explanation: I should like to live... 英式委婉意愿：= would like，语气更正式。

examples.en: I should like to save my life.

points.title: no longer/not any longer 表不再
points.explanation: The individual is no longer... 表状态终结；与 no more（数量）辨析。

examples.en: Some old people are oppressed by the fear of death.
examples.cn: 有些老年人被死亡的恐惧所压迫。
